realism.how: Illegal home distilling was common in Eastern-bloc villages: a farmer took a dairy milk can or a big pot, a few metres of copper or steel pipe and a cooling barrel, and ran it behind the barn on a brick stove. The materials are whatever the collective farm threw out.
realism.current: An improvised still is current for that trade: pressure-cooker or milk-can pots with copper tubing were what a 1989 distiller really used. A gleaming copper alembic would be a museum piece, so it scores low.
